title: Pointed finite-coset limit and normalized splitting data
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], and $G$ a profinite group with left actions on the finite geometric fibres [def-galois-fibre-functor] of finite etale covers [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category], in compatible small universes [def-weil-size-convention]. Write $\mathrm{FEt}(X)\to\mathrm{Sch}/X$ for the forgetful functor. A pointed coset system is a functor $N\mapsto Y_N$ from open normal subgroups, with connected $Y_N$, equivariant fibre identifications $G/N\simeq (Y_N)_x$, and transitions $aM\mapsto aN$. A pointed coset limit is a limiting cone $(T,p_N)$ in schemes over $X$, a compatible point $t$ over $x$ mapping to the identity coset at every stage, and connectedness of $T$. A normalized splitting datum on this limit consists of maps $f_s:T\to Y$ uniquely characterized by $f_s(t)=s$, whose graphs form the coproduct $T\times_XY=\coprod_{s\in Y_x}T$ [def-pc-fibre-product] [def-galois-finite-coproduct]; for every open normal $N$ killing $Y_x$, unique maps $f_{s,N}:Y_N\to Y$ with fibre formula $aN\mapsto as$, factorization $f_{s,N}p_N=f_s$, and compatibility with refinements and maps of covers; and unique $X$-automorphisms $d_g$ with $p_Nd_g=f_{gN}$, satisfying $f_sd_g=f_{gs}$, $d_1=1$, and $d_hd_g=d_{gh}$. This defines the data and their properties, without asserting that such data exist.
